cohort: The study included women with a singleton breech presentation delivered from gestational week 35 onwards at Hammerfest Hospital between 2004 and 2023.
finding: Twenty years of data from Hammerfest's maternity ward support the practice of selecting women for planned vaginal breech delivery.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal deliveries resulted in emergency caesarean sections in 62% of cases, and Apgar scores < 7 at 5 minutes were low across all modes of delivery, with no incidences of severe neonatal morbidity or mortality.
